fc99b38a3b4e7623.description: About the Role Quintessentially is seeking an Owner Relationship Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Record owner preferences, milestones, communication protocols, and service needs accurately within approved systems. Coordinate owner introductions, appointments, site visits, consultations, and handover ceremonies. Collaborate with property delivery, engineering, and project teams to confirm readiness for handover and track outstanding items. Ensure seamless preparation and execution across all owner touchpoints with internal teams. Coordinate the timely transfer of approved documentation and communications to community management post-handover. Maintain close coordination with the client’s delivery, community management, and sales teams. Manage the follow-up of owner requests and service actions, documenting responsibilities, due dates, and progress. Proactively identify and flag risks related to handover readiness or owner satisfaction, recommending solutions. fcfd62d3ffe5b4d7.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company (QIC) is a PIF-backed giga-project integral to Saudi Vision 2030, focusing on building a vibrant society, a thriving economy, and an ambitious nation. QIC is developing Qiddiya City in Riyadh, a futuristic destination that will feature world-class attractions, sports complexes, cultural landmarks, and residential neighborhoods, bringing entertainment, sports, and culture to the forefront. Role Overview Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Specialist Security Operations National Liaison AA to join the team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 3-5 years of experience and involves acting as a key liaison officer between the Command and Control Unit (CCU) and various government agencies, ensuring seamless coordination and compliance with security protocols and regulatory requirements. Key Duties and Responsibilities Act as the CCU's working-level liaison officer with Ministry of Interior agencies, Public Security, Civil Defence, Qiddiya Police, the Patrol Dispatch Centre, and the Principality of Riyadh Province. Maintain current contacts, coordination matrices, and escalation routes under the Joint Security Operating Model (JSOM). Coordinate government approvals, permits, inspections, and completion certificates for events, openings, drone operations, fireworks, and other regulated activities, tracking each to completion with venue and project teams. Support joint coordination arrangements, including liaison-officer frameworks, information-sharing protocols, joint meetings, workshops, and exercises with authorities. Prepare and translate correspondence, briefings, reports, and presentations in Arabic and English for government stakeholders, ensuring accuracy, protocol, and appropriate tone. Support the dissemination and upkeep of the JSOM across Ministry of Interior sub-departments, including workshops and maintaining contact details. Coordinate official visits, delegations, and inspections to the CCU and Qiddiya assets with Security, Event Management, and venues. Maintain the register of government engagements, commitments, actions, and reporting obligations, including reporting to the Principality and shareholder requirements. Provide liaison support during incidents and heightened alert states, relaying information between the CCU and authorities and recording decisions. Support drone-governance interfaces with authorities alongside the Manager - Airspace. Specific Responsibilities Maintain the authority contact directory and liaison-officer roster with periodic verification. Log and track permit and approval applications, providing status reports to the Assistant Manager - Security and the CCU. Produce bilingual briefing notes, letters, and minutes to QIC standards. Support the Alert State process and national alert notifications within the CCU. Support government-facing exercises, drills, and familiarisation visits, including Civil Defence site familiarisation. Maintain protocol guidance for hosting government officials at Qiddiya. General Responsibilities and Expectations Contribute to planning, reporting, and continual improvement within the function. Support and share knowledge with colleagues, operators, and client teams. Promote a culture of accountability, safety, and continual improvement. Maintain accurate records and provide timely reports and recommendations to the line manager. Perform other related duties consistent with the role and business requirements, including support to incidents, exercises, and events outside normal hours. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 3-5 years of relevant experience in security operations, government liaison, or a related field. Strong communication skills in both Arabic and English are essential for preparing and translating official correspondence and briefings.

fc64f2b882b0f81c.description: About the Role Orient Insurance KSA is seeking a Compliance Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for ensuring the company's adherence to all applicable laws, regulations, and regulatory requirements issued by the Insurance Authority (IA) and other relevant authorities within Saudi Arabia. The Compliance Manager will also be responsible for fostering a robust compliance culture and mitigating regulatory risks across the organization. Key Responsibilities Ensure compliance with Insurance Authority (IA) regulations, insurance laws, and applicable regulatory requirements. Develop, implement, and maintain the company's compliance policies and procedures. Monitor regulatory updates and ensure timely implementation of new requirements. Conduct compliance risk assessments and monitor potential regulatory breaches. Provide compliance guidance and training to employees and management. Coordinate regulatory reporting and communications with the Insurance Authority and other relevant authorities. Investigate compliance breaches and recommend corrective actions. Prepare periodic compliance reports for senior management and the Board. Coordinate with internal audit, risk management, and other departments to ensure effective governance and compliance. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of regulatory frameworks within the insurance sector in Saudi Arabia. This role requires a professional who can proactively manage compliance risks and effectively communicate complex regulatory information to various stakeholders. Experience Required Candidates should have 5-10 years of relevant experience in compliance, preferably within the insurance industry. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to a key function within Orient Insurance KSA. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

fc6b426f090ee284.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة سمايا عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، بمنطقة عسير. تهدف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام داخل المنشأة من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الأمن. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوقائع. الالتزام التام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في المنشأة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراقبة الأماكن والممتلكات بفعالية. القدرة على التعامل مع حالات الطوارئ والاستجابة السريعة. المهارات الشخصية مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع الزوار والموظفين. الانتباه للتفاصيل واليقظة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة أبها، بمنطقة عسير، ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة تلتزم بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى مجموعة سمايا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الوظيفة في أقرب وقت ممكن.

fcb5f44df8f18b41.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Management platform designed to help organizations understand, engage with, and serve their customers at scale. The platform integrates customer intelligence, omnichannel engagement, and agentic AI to enable teams to convert customer insights into actionable strategies. As Lucidya expands across enterprise and government markets, ensuring customer data protection and building trust are fundamental to its product development and business operations. Role Overview Lucidya is seeking a Director of Information Security (Saudi Only) to lead and scale the company’s security function. This full-time leadership role involves overseeing security across products, cloud infrastructure, the corporate environment, and compliance programs. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the Director will be responsible for the security roadmap, building and leading the security team, and collaborating with various departments including Engineering, Product, SRE, DevOps, IT, Legal, People, Sales, and Customer Experience. The position requires a hands-on approach to translate security requirements into practical controls, clear ownership, and measurable progress. Key Responsibilities Define and execute Lucidya’s security strategy and roadmap, aligning with business priorities and customer commitments. Lead, mentor, and develop the security team, establishing clear responsibilities and development plans. Drive agentic transformation in team operations, applying AI agents to tasks such as alert triage, evidence collection, vulnerability management, and security questionnaires. Manage security policies, standards, risk assessments, and the risk register, including processes for exceptions, risk acceptance, and escalation. Oversee security tooling, service providers, and budget, reporting on posture, risks, and incidents to executive leadership. Lead the implementation and maintenance of controls for Saudi PDPL, NCA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other relevant frameworks. Maintain the Information Security Management System and coordinate control ownership across departments. Ensure audit evidence is accurate and prepared, manage audit preparation and findings, and verify the effective operation of documented controls. Partner with Legal on data protection, retention, access, and contractual security requirements. Embed security into architecture, development, testing, and deployment, including automated scanning of code, dependencies, secrets, containers, and infrastructure. Define release security criteria, remediation timelines, and exception processes. Lead threat modeling and security reviews for major product changes, integrations, and AI capabilities. Oversee penetration testing, adversarial testing, and vulnerability assessments through to verified resolution. Review security across AWS and GCP (identity, privileged access, networking, encryption, secrets, logging) and maintain visibility over internet-facing assets. Set security requirements for employee devices, identities, and internal applications, collaborating with IT for implementation and verification. Oversee access reviews during onboarding, role changes, and offboarding. Conduct security awareness training, phishing exercises, and targeted education for technical and business teams. Assess the security risk of third-party tools and vendors handling company or customer data. Define and verify network and physical security standards for the office site. Own the security operations model, including internal responsibilities, external SOC/MDR providers, monitoring coverage, and after-hours escalation. Oversee log collection, detection, alert triage, and investigation across cloud, application, identity, endpoint, and network. Maintain incident response plans and playbooks, lead incident coordination and post-incident reviews, and run regular simulations. Collaborate with Legal, leadership, and customer teams on timely and accurate notifications when incidents affect customers. Manage Lucidya’s vulnerability disclosure program from researcher contact through closure. Support Sales and Customer Experience with security questionnaires, assessments, and technical discussions, utilizing approved assurance materials. Review proposed customer security commitments to ensure accuracy and achievability. Serve as the primary security contact for auditors, testing providers, and customer security teams. Qualifications and Experience 8+ years of progressive experience in information security, with at least 3 years leading security teams or programs. Experience securing a SaaS platform or comparable cloud-based software environment. Demonstrated track record spanning both technical security and governance, risk, and compliance. Hands-on experience implementing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls, including direct involvement in external audits. Practical familiarity with Saudi PDPL and NCA requirements, and the ability to translate them into technical controls and evidence. Experience leading investigations, incident response, and vulnerability remediation across multiple teams. Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 8-10 years of relevant experience. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

fcdb9795fced6a04.description: About the Role MSI Qatar is seeking an FP&R Manager to join its team in Dhahran. This full-time position requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in financial planning and reporting. Key Responsibilities Conduct financial reporting and analysis, including the development of financial statements. Prepare budgeting and forecasting reports. Perform reconciliation and monthly accrual reporting. Manage taxation aspects, including reporting and compliance checks. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in financial planning and reporting. Demonstrated knowledge of accounting standards, specifically IFRS. Experience in group reporting. Essential Skills Strong analytical skills, including financial analysis and problem-solving capabilities. Effective communication skills for interacting with various internal and external stakeholders. Proficiency in planning and strategic decision-making. A solid understanding of compliance and governance principles. Work Setting This is a full-time position based in Dhahran, offering an opportunity to contribute to MSI Qatar's financial operations. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role.

fca5db343a81105b.description: About the Role National Medical Care is seeking a Financial Analyst to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves supporting the Financial Planning and Reporting Head in preparing financial statements, conducting analysis, and managing budgeting activities. The role requires effective communication with operational teams to ensure timely data gathering and support in financial analysis. Key Responsibilities Consolidate and analyze financial data, including budgets and forecasts, aligning with company goals and financial standing. Assemble and summarize data to create detailed reports on financial status and potential risks. Propose solutions and recommendations to reduce costs and enhance financial performance. Develop financial models, conduct benchmarking, and perform process analysis. Conduct business studies on past, future, and comparative performance, and develop forecast models. Identify financial trends and recommend actions to senior management based on thorough analysis. Track and determine financial status by analyzing actual results against forecasts, budgets, and competitor performance. Consult with management to support long-term and strategic decision-making with financial analysis. Coordinate with operational teams for monthly book closings, data gathering, and timely submission. Prepare monthly financial reports, including Balance Sheets, Income Statements, Cash Flows, and other necessary disclosures. Coordinate with operational teams for analysis justifications and reconciliation of P&L, BS, and CF to ensure accurate and timely reporting. Support the preparation of the annual budget and analysis, as well as the presentation of monthly financial statements. Collect ad-hoc and necessary data from operations as required. Assist new finance team members to maintain and improve service quality and technical expertise. Provide assistance to the Financial Controller regarding reporting and related matters essential for financial management. Align with financial managers in implementing new controls and reporting structures. Assist in preparing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure reporting smoothness and alignment with company goals. Prepare analytical reports and track progress against budgets by groups and teams periodically. Report performance and variance analysis to the line manager. Perform additional tasks and duties as assigned by superiors. Reporting Structure This position reports directly to the Financial Planning and Analysis Head and does not involve supervisory responsibilities. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in financial analysis and reporting. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic financial planning and reporting team.

fcb73f11b18de353.description: اعلان وظيفي – موظفة استقبال (سعودية الجنسية) الوصف الوظيفي: تعلن شركة نايا كلينك الطبي عن حاجتها إلى موظفة استقبال سعودية الجنسية، تتمتع باللباقة وحسن التعامل والقدرة على التواصل الفعّال، للقيام بالمهام التالية: استقبال الزوار والعملاء والترحيب بهم. الرد على المكالمات الهاتفية وتحويلها للجهات المختصة. تقديم الدعم الإداري والمساعدة في الأعمال المكتبية. متابعة وتنظيم مهام الاستقبال اليومية. المحافظة على المظهر المهني وحسن التعامل مع العملاء. متطلبات الوظيفة: أن تكون المتقدمة سعودية الجنسية. اللباقة وحسن المظهر والتعامل. إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي. امتلاك مهارات التواصل والتنظيم. الالتزام والانضباط في العمل. ساعات وأيام العمل: عدد ساعات العمل: 8 ساعات يومياً. أيام العمل: 6 أيام في الأسبوع. الإجازة الأسبوعية: يوم الجمعة. الراتب: يحدد الراتب بعد المقابلة الشخصية، بناءً على الخبرة والكفاءة والمهارات العملية للمتقدمة.

fc01600cbe1d1c4e.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Specialist - IT Security Delivery to join their team. This full-time role involves overseeing the readiness, testing, and controlled handover of IT security programs. The specialist will ensure adherence to security standards and manage the delivery process for both corporate and asset IT Security initiatives. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage build readiness, orchestrate testing, and facilitate controlled handovers. This includes coordinating with the Design team for necessary inputs, enforcing gates, resolving defects, and producing audit-ready validation packs for assigned IT Security programs. Core Responsibilities Operate exit-gate governance across environments, verifying prerequisites such as access, certifications, backups, and rollback plans. Supervise Go/No-Go forums, ensuring documentation of risks, exceptions, and compensating controls with Cybersecurity sign-off. Maintain change calendars aligned with asset windows and blackout periods. Oversee the development of end-to-end test plans covering functional, negative, resilience, and integration scenarios, ensuring observer participation for test credibility. Manage defect triage, assigning owners and severity, and tracking fix SLAs and re-tests. Maintain RAID logs, escalate blockers, and quantify residual risk at release. Supervise the compilation of validation packs, including plans, results, evidence, and traceability matrices, ensuring versioned storage and approvals. Ensure first-pass acceptance by QA/Excellence and facilitate quick resolution of any returns. Validate runbooks, monitoring/alerting, and L1/L2 training completion, confirming operational SLOs and DR artifacts. Confirm SIEM/SOAR mappings and case workflows prior to go-live. Facilitate cutover rehearsals, publish communication plans, RACI matrices, and hyper care schedules. Provide weekly readiness dashboards and risk summaries to governance forums. Track change success rates and update checklists accordingly for continuous improvement. Security Control Evaluation and Implementation Lead the evaluation of IT Security controls, technologies, and solutions to ensure alignment with organizational strategy, Cybersecurity requirements, business priorities, and operational needs. Oversee Proof of Concept (POC) activities, including scope definition, success criteria, stakeholder alignment, execution oversight, and outcome reporting. Assess solution suitability based on security effectiveness, integration capability, scalability, compliance alignment, operational impact, supportability, and long-term value. Recommend fit-for-purpose IT Security controls and technology solutions based on outcomes, risk reduction value, operational readiness, and enterprise direction. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in IT security delivery, with a strong background in managing security programs and ensuring operational readiness. The role requires a professional who can coordinate effectively with various teams and stakeholders to achieve security objectives. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

fc33f5d117c91eec.description: About the Role Accenture Security is seeking a Digital Identity & Access Management Consultant to join our team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting clients in implementing and optimizing Digital Identity solutions across various domains, including Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and directory services. The consultant will be responsible for requirements gathering, solution configuration, and providing expert advice on identity security best practices. Key Responsibilities Define client requirements for PAM (Delinea), IAM (One Identity), MFA (Azure MFA & FortiAuthenticator), and Active Directory/DNS solutions. Assess existing identity processes and recommend improvements to enhance security and efficiency. Develop comprehensive Digital Identity strategies, architectures, and implementation plans. Configure and customize PAM, IAM, MFA, and AD/DNS solutions according to client specifications. Build and maintain identity policies, covering privileged access, authentication, authorization, and lifecycle management. Collaborate with security, IT, and compliance teams to ensure seamless integration of identity services. Provide training, support, and documentation to clients for implemented solutions. Liaise with vendors such as Delinea, Microsoft, and One Identity for technical and platform-related matters. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in Digital Identity and Access Management. Demonstrated experience with PAM (Delinea), IAM (One Identity), MFA (Azure MFA & FortiAuthenticator), and Active Directory/DNS. Ability to gather requirements, configure solutions, and advise on best practices. Career Development and Environment Accenture Security offers a transparent and fast-paced approach to career progression, focusing on individual strengths and providing continuous coaching from senior colleagues. Consultants will work alongside Accenture experts, addressing industry challenges with innovative thinking and pioneering tools. The role provides access to state-of-the-art technology, fostering skill development and contributing to the latest business trends. Flexible work arrangements and competitive rewards are part of the benefits package. Location This position is based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

fc42288fe47ea547.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تقنية النانو للمطابخ عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات واستراتيجيات المبيعات، وتقييم الأداء، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة لدعم الأهداف البيعية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق، وتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع، وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية فعالة. اقتراح سياسات البيع، ومتابعة تنفيذ السياسات والطرق البيعية، ووضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم واحتياجاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم نتائج أعمال مندوبي البيع، وتقييم مدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع سياسات واستراتيجيات المبيعات ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات تحليلية لتقييم نتائج المبيعات وتحديد مجالات التحسين. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحقيق الأهداف المشتركة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المبيعات في شركة تقنية النانو للمطابخ، ومقرها في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

fc9bd017936ac4cd.description: About the Role Al Jomaih Energy and Water is seeking an HCIS Security Manager to join their team in Rabigh. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the implementation and compliance of all HCIS requirements on-site during the construction phase of projects. The HCIS Security Manager will act as the primary liaison with HCIS authorities, ensuring all documentation, communication, and execution align with HCIS Security and Safety Standards. Once HCIS activities are established, the role will also support the HSE team and contribute to quality procedures. Key Responsibilities Oversee the development and implementation of HCIS requirements within the project. Manage the preparation and submission of HCIS documents to the HCIS authority in coordination with the EPC Contractor. Ensure continuous compliance with HCIS Standards and Specifications. Facilitate effective communication and coordination with HCIS authorities through necessary visits and serving as the primary focal point. Lead and document comprehensive HCIS security risk assessments (physical, cyber, personnel) across all project phases. Develop and oversee the implementation of mitigation plans for identified risks. Oversee the preparation, review, submission, and approval of all HCIS-related documentation, including Security Master Plans, Risk Assessments, Security System Designs, and Compliance Reports, in coordination with SPV, EPC, and O&M contractors. Conduct regular internal audits and inspections to verify ongoing compliance with HCIS standards and facilitate external audits. Track and ensure the closure of any identified non-conformities. Monitor contractor security performance and ensure full understanding and compliance with HCIS obligations. Provide regular reports to SPV management and HCIS authorities on compliance status, risks, incidents, and mitigation actions. HSE Support Responsibilities (Post HCIS Control Phase) Ensure all on-site personnel attend relevant HSE inductions and trainings. Maintain updated HSE procedures for specific tasks. Perform routine and random HSE inspections to monitor procedure implementation and follow up on corrective actions. Report anomalies, violations, and unsafe practices immediately. Promote a proactive and positive intervention approach within the Project team. Disseminate HSE rules, standards, procedures, and communications on site. Participate in daily meetings, Tool Box, and Pre-Job Talks. Ensure compliance with risk assessments and preparation of Job Safety Analyses (JSAs). Advise on safe operative techniques and methodologies for planning and safety control. Ensure adequate HSE reporting in line with project procedures. Inspect subcontractors' activities and control equipment compliance. Monitor the effective implementation of the Permit to Work system. Ensure timely reporting of any HSE event and assist in accident investigations. Monitor and maintain control measures for hazardous materials. Conduct follow-up on regular formal inspections with Subcontractors' representatives. Coordinate activities and set daily objectives for HSE Officers. Participate in LTA site visits and coordinate to address observations or comments promptly. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated experience in implementing and ensuring compliance with HCIS requirements. Strong understanding of HCIS Security and Safety Standards. Experience in coordinating with regulatory authorities. Ability to lead risk assessments and develop mitigation plans. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Rabigh, focusing on on-site operations during the construction phase. The role requires active engagement with various stakeholders, including HCIS authorities, EPC, SPV, and O&M contractors, as well as internal HSE teams.

fcee5469229c89e0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة نبت للمقاولات عن مهندس زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خصائص الأراضي والتربة الزراعية، وتصميم شبكات الري والصرف، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة ومتابعة استخداماتها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام الرئيسية دراسة خصائص ومكونات الأراضي والتربة الزراعية الفيزيائية والكيميائية. متابعة فحص عينات النبات والتربة ومياه الري وتحليل نتائجها. دراسة واختبار أنواع الأسمدة المناسبة وتقييم مدى استجابة المزروعات لها. دراسة أنظمة الري واختيار الأنسب منها (كالري السطحي، بالرشاشات، المحوري، أو الموضعي). تصميم مخططات وشبكات الري والصرف الزراعي ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب. تقييم كفاءة أنظمة الري وتطويرها لتحقيق أفضل أداء. تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة (مثل آلات الحراثة، الزراعة، الرش، الحصاد، جرش وخلط الحبوب). إعداد برامج تشغيل وصيانة الآلات الزراعية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للعمل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة جامعية في الهندسة الزراعية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الزراعية. معرفة قوية بخصائص التربة، أنظمة الري، والآلات الزراعية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الزراعي ضمن فريق مؤسسة نبت للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمهام الموكلة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الزراعيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا لتقديم طلباتهم.

fcf5bb1944099b8e.description: About the Role Ninja is seeking a Live Operations Supervisor to lead the Live Operations team within its Food division. This full-time role focuses on enhancing restaurant partner performance by overseeing daily operations, monitoring key performance indicators, and driving improvements in critical areas such as restaurant availability, cancellation rates, and service quality. The supervisor will collaborate with Commercial, Logistics, and Customer Care teams to address operational challenges and improve both partner and customer experiences. Key Responsibilities Monitor restaurant partner performance, including online availability, cancellation rates, and the accuracy of branch operating hours. Analyze performance trends, identify root causes of operational issues, and implement corrective action plans. Lead, coach, and develop the Live Operations team to achieve productivity and quality targets. Plan weekly schedules to ensure adequate staffing and shift coverage. Review tickets, calls, and operational interactions to maintain service quality and compliance with agreed response and resolution times. fcdcfc098f5d3348.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة حسن انس فارسي القابضة عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة التمديدات الكهربائية، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف التطبيقات (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات مع مطابقة مواصفاتها. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأجهزة التمديدات الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة ضمن فريق عمل شركة حسن انس فارسي القابضة. يتوقع من الفني العمل في بيئات مختلفة تتطلب تطبيق المعرفة الفنية والالتزام بمعايير السلامة. عن الشركة شركة حسن انس فارسي القابضة هي كيان يعمل في المدينة المنورة ويسعى لضم الكفاءات المتخصصة إلى فريقه لتعزيز جودة الخدمات والأعمال المقدمة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة حسن انس فارسي القابضة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الوظيفة في المدينة المنورة.

fc5157e52fdc3eee.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كوينتوم بيلدرز عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تسويق وبيع بطاريات شحن المركبات الكهربائية للأفراد، واستقطاب عملاء جدد، وتحقيق المستهدفات البيعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تسويق وبيع بطاريات شحن المركبات الكهربائية للأفراد (B2C). استقطاب العملاء الجدد وشرح مواصفات ومميزات البطاريات. تقديم العروض السعرية ومتابعة العملاء لإتمام عمليات البيع. تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية المحددة. وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج. دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق وتحديد الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية. تقييم نتائج أعمال مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية واقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية. فهم جيد لعمليات البيع والتسويق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. مهارات تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص البيعية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بدوام كامل. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق الأهداف المحددة للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

fc1d284b94fcd253.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دبيب للتأجير عن مدير تطوير موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى هذا الدور قيادة إدارة الأداء والتطوير التنظيمي، وتحسين جودة التوظيف والتأهيل، وتطوير مدراء الفروع ضمن بيئة عمل مؤتمتة ومتعددة الفروع. يتطلب الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة إدارة الأداء وتطوير مؤشرات ومستهدفات وحوافز ملائمة لطبيعة كل وظيفة بالتعاون مع أقسام التشغيل والمالية. تشخيص أسباب ضعف الأداء وتنفيذ خطط تحسين وتدريب قابلة للقياس بالتعاون مع مدراء الفروع. تطوير الأدوار والمسؤوليات والجدارات وخطط الاحتياج والتأهيل والتعاقب الوظيفي بما يتناسب مع المنشأة. تحسين عملية اختيار الموظفين من خلال المقابلات المنظمة والاختبارات العملية ومتابعة جودة التعيين. تطوير المدراء وقيادة برامج التدريب وقياس أثرها على النتائج وجودة الخدمة وتقليل الأخطاء. معالجة شكاوى الموظفين وإدارة التحقيقات والاستماع للأطراف وتوثيق القرارات وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. متابعة الحالات المحولة بين الأقسام حتى إغلاقها بدليل ومنع تكرارها. مراجعة جودة بيانات العقود والحضور والإجازات والرواتب والعهد ومعالجة الاستثناءات بالتنسيق مع المختصين. إعداد تحليلات تتضمن المشكلة وأثرها والحل والمسؤول والموعد ومقياس النجاح. تحسين الاستفادة من الأتمتة والذكاء الاصطناعي والتحقق من دقة النتائج والمحافظة على سرية البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية. إجادة تحليل البيانات باستخدام Excel أو Power BI. القدرة على استخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي والتحقق من مخرجاتها. معرفة عملية بأنظمة العمل السعودية. معايير التوظيف تعطى الأولوية للخبرة والإنجازات المثبتة والاختبار العملي. لا تشترط شهادات مهنية محددة لهذا الدور. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذا الإعلان.

fc516700d8b40f36.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Reliability Engineer with expertise in Gasification & Power Generation. This full-time position is based onsite in Jazan, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on ensuring the reliability, availability, efficiency, and safety of critical equipment and systems within gasification and power generation operations. Role Purpose and Context The Reliability Engineer is responsible for implementing strategic preventive and predictive maintenance, conducting thorough investigations into equipment failures, and analyzing performance data. This role is crucial for driving continuous improvement initiatives aimed at minimizing downtime and optimizing overall asset performance in a demanding operational environment. Key Responsibilities Monitor equipment performance and reliability to identify potential risks and areas for enhancement. Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to reduce equipment failures and unplanned downtime. Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and failure investigations to address recurring equipment issues effectively. Analyze equipment performance data, maintenance records, and reliability trends to recommend improvements. Apply established reliability methodologies such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM). Collaborate with operations and maintenance teams to enhance equipment availability and operational efficiency. Ensure adherence to applicable safety, environmental, and industry standards. Prepare comprehensive reliability reports, risk assessments, and recommendations for stakeholders. Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives utilizing reliability tools and emerging technologies. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant reliability engineering role, specifically within gasification and power generation operations. A strong understanding of the principles and application of reliability engineering is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time, onsite position located in Jazan, Saudi Arabia. The role requires active collaboration with various operational and maintenance teams to achieve reliability objectives.

fc9dee53e4fd3187.description: About Assystem Radicon Assystem's mission is to accelerate the global energy transition by developing low-carbon energy solutions. With 7,000 "Switchers" across 12 countries, the company combines engineering expertise and project management with digital technologies. Assystem focuses on the production and distribution of low-carbon electricity through nuclear and renewable energies, modernizing energy grids, and utilizing hydrogen for decarbonization in transport and industry sectors. Assystem in Türkiye is recognized for its work with public and private sectors, specializing in ESIA studies, site investigations, and laboratory research. The company provides vital site supervision and engineering services for owners and lenders, playing a key role in major projects such as power generation and the construction of the Akkuyu nuclear power plant. Role Overview Assystem Radicon is seeking a Lead Digital Consultant to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires over 10 years of experience and involves leading the functional design, configuration, and implementation of application-specific solutions. The role focuses on translating business requirements into practical system configurations and providing expert support. Key Responsibilities Lead application-specific functional design, configuration, and solution implementation. Translate business requirements into workflows, forms, permissions, reports, dashboards, and system configurations. Validate product suitability and recommend best-fit configuration approaches aligned with business needs. Resolve complex functional issues and provide expert-level troubleshooting and support. Define and enforce configuration standards, governance practices, and release acceptance criteria. Support testing, release readiness, deployment validation, and post-implementation stabilization. Lead end-user, administrator, and super-user training, knowledge transfer, and adoption activities. Prepare and maintain functional documentation, configuration guides, and operating procedures. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated experience in all highlighted tools and technologies relevant to the responsibilities. Work Environment and Culture This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Assystem is committed to equal treatment of candidates and promotes diversity within the company. The organization believes that diverse backgrounds and perspectives are essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions, valuing skills, talent, and the ability to dare.

fc22bc74415b9b64.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رؤيا المستقبل للمقاولات عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ ومراقبة إجراءات الموارد البشرية، بما في ذلك دوام الموظفين، الإجازات، وتحديث البيانات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى ضمان التطبيق الفعال لسياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى التعامل المهني مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. كما يشمل الدور إعداد وتوثيق التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة ودقة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بأنواعها المختلفة، وتعديل النماذج حسب الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويد فريق خدمات الموظفين بها، بما في ذلك تسجيل وتوثيق الترقيات، الدورات التدريبية، والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم جيد لإجراءات وأنظمة الموارد البشرية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. دقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل في تحديث البيانات وتوثيق المعلومات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الأقسام المختلفة. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة المهام المتعددة بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، ويوفر فرصة للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة رؤيا المستقبل للمقاولات.

fc81e11c6817a31a.description: About the Role Hempel A/S is seeking a Project Sales Manager for Decorative Projects to drive growth in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province and Bahrain. This full-time position is based in Dammam, 1st Industrial Dist, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role focuses on leading sales teams, securing projects, and building relationships within the construction and infrastructure sectors. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute project sales strategies to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share objectives across Saudi Arabia's Eastern Region and Bahrain. Manage and develop a high-performing project sales team through coaching, performance management, and capability building. Identify, qualify, and secure new project opportunities within the construction, real estate, and infrastructure sectors. Build and strengthen relationships with architects, consultants, developers, contractors, and key project stakeholders. Lead project specification and acquisition activities to position Hempel products in strategic projects. Drive customer satisfaction by ensuring service and effective resolution of customer concerns. fc8bc90fb9eec1ce.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره عن مشرف مكتب للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على العمليات المكتبية اليومية وضمان سيرها بسلاسة وفعالية وفقًا للخطط المحددة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإشراف المكتبي. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف اليومي على جميع أعمال المكتب لضمان تنفيذ الإجراءات بسلاسة وفعالية. مراقبة جدولة المواعيد والتأكد من حسن سيرها وفقًا للخطط الموضوعة. ضمان تنظيم المكتب ونظافته بشكل مستمر، واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة للحفاظ على ذلك. التأكد من توافر جميع المستلزمات المكتبية الضرورية عند الحاجة، ووفقًا للخطط المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإشراف المكتبي أو دور مماثل. القدرة على الإشراف على العمليات اليومية وضمان الامتثال للخطط. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الحضور المنتظم في المكتب. نوع التوظيف هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

fcb758b6d3e62614.description: About the Role Smartech AV is seeking an Audio Visual Technician to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, on-site position responsible for the installation, configuration, and testing of audio visual systems in various client environments. The role requires a professional with 2-5 years of experience in the field. Role Overview The Audio Visual Technician will be based in Riyadh or other locations within the Kingdom, focusing on delivering high-quality AV solutions. This position involves working with a range of equipment, including displays, projectors, lighting, speakers, and control systems, primarily within control rooms, meeting spaces, and public venues. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, and test audio visual systems. Perform routine and corrective maintenance on AV equipment. Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to AV systems. Support video conferencing setups to ensure reliable system performance. Read and interpret technical drawings and schematics. Coordinate effectively with project engineers. Prepare necessary equipment and cabling for installations. Conduct system checks and quality assurance procedures before project handover. Provide user support and basic training on AV system operation. Document all work performed accurately. Adhere to all safety and company standards on site. Proficiency in working with various AV components including displays, projectors, lighting, speakers, and control equipment. Ability to read and understand technical documentation. Work Environment This is an on-site, full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role may require travel to various client locations within the Kingdom to perform installations and maintenance. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

fc2b23066fa3333e.description: About Tamara Tamara is a prominent fintech platform operating in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region. The company focuses on providing simple, trusted, and accessible financial solutions. With a customer base exceeding 25 million and a network of 130,000 partner merchants, Tamara delivers financial services across various sectors. The company is supported by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned entity of the Public Investment Fund, and SNB Capital. The Role: Senior Data Engineering Manager Tamara is seeking a Senior Data Engineering Manager to lead a critical area within its engineering organization in Riyadh. This full-time role involves accountability for delivery and technical strategy across multiple complex product domains. The manager will lead a high-performing team of 6-10 senior engineers, potentially structured across two squads, and will drive team-level goals aligned with broader organizational priorities. The position requires leveraging deep expertise in software development and proven leadership to guide the architectural evolution of systems, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance. The Senior Data Engineering Manager will partner with product and business leadership to influence medium- and long-term strategy and ensure teams deliver measurable impact. Key Responsibilities Inspire and guide senior engineers, setting a clear direction aligned with the company vision. Drive alignment between technology goals and product priorities, advocating for long-term technical quality alongside short-term delivery. Develop direct reports and skip-levels for future leadership roles, creating growth opportunities for senior engineers and mentoring aspiring managers. Lead architectural discussions for the team's systems and drive continuous improvements to system reliability, performance, and scalability. Define and own delivery plans for initiatives spanning multiple teams, managing resource allocation and hiring strategy for the area. Proactively identify and resolve complex cross-team delivery challenges, making strategic trade-offs between short- and long-term value. Partner directly with Product and business leadership to influence medium- and long-term product strategies, ensuring teams focus on measurable outcomes and ROI. Build a healthy, inclusive environment of trust, ownership, and accountability, fostering strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing. Required Qualifications and Experience At least 4+ years of experience managing one or more engineering teams, with a proven track record of managing senior individual contributors and leading projects of medium-to-high complexity. Demonstrated experience owning delivery for initiatives spanning multiple teams or complex product domains. Strong technical background in modern software development (*, Java/Go, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Messaging Queues, Cloud Services), with experience leading architectural discussions and driving technical strategy. Experience partnering with product managers to influence product roadmaps and align technical strategy with business objectives. Proven ability to develop engineering talent, including mentoring senior engineers and aspiring managers. Expertise in Agile methodologies and experience resolving complex, cross-team delivery challenges in a fast-paced environment. Fintech or eCommerce experience is considered a strong advantage. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a driven, determined, and curious leader with a positive, solution-oriented outlook. They should be able to persevere through challenges, work effectively with others through empathy and respect, and respond quickly with urgency, adapting course without losing momentum. The role requires 4+ years of relevant experience.

fc3887cc92336b44.description: About CAMCO - Capital Metro Company CAMCO – Capital Metro Company is a Saudi-French joint venture formed by RATP Dev and SAPTCO. The company is responsible for the operation and maintenance of the Blue and Red Lines of the Riyadh Metro. With over 3,000 employees, CAMCO plays a key role in operating one of the world's largest fully automated metro networks, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient metro services across Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Role of Signalling Technician The Signalling Technician is responsible for executing preventive and corrective maintenance of signalling equipment. This role involves analyzing disruptions, implementing preventive measures in collaboration with supervisors and external providers, and troubleshooting systems and equipment to ensure operational integrity. The position is full-time and based in Riyadh. Key Responsibilities Execute preventive and corrective maintenance, including repairs of systems, following instructions from superior personnel. Read repair manuals and implement safe work methodologies. Conduct tasks according to work schedules and periodic inspection plans (daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly). Prepare tools and materials required for maintenance activities. Prepare failure documentation and submit it to superiors through the CMMS. Monitor commissioning, testing, and trial operation activities of signalling equipment, reporting recurring defects and disruptions to the concerned Shift Supervisor or Engineer. Monitor and maintain signalling interface and integration with other disciplines. Operate special tools and measuring devices necessary for maintenance and repair tasks. Perform maintenance activities that require working at height, on track, in stations, and in depots. Ensure safety-critical communication protocols are followed. Adhere to all required safety rules, regulations, and procedures. Perform other related tasks as assigned by superiors. Qualifications and Experience Vocational training in Electronics or Communications Systems is required. A minimum of 2-3 years of relevant work experience in the maintenance of system signalling assets is necessary. Experience in a railway or metro organization, or other relevant industry, is preferred. Preference will be given to qualified Saudi nationals. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic operational environment that supports one of the world's largest automated metro networks.

fc16f1fbdf991aa2.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز الطب المتقدم للتخصصات الدقيقة عن كاتب مركز اتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويهدف إلى تقديم دعم فعال للعملاء من خلال إدارة المكالمات الواردة والصادرة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تلقي الطلبات الواردة عبر الهاتف والرد على استفسارات العملاء الأساسية، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة. إجراء المكالمات الصادرة لأغراض التسويق الهاتفي، والتعامل مع العملاء، وتقديم خدمات المنتجات، ومتابعة تحصيل الديون. تصعيد المكالمات التي تتطلب معلومات إضافية أو استجابات فنية إلى المستويات المختصة لضمان تلبية احتياجات العملاء. إعداد تقارير يومية تتضمن إجمالي عدد المكالمات، والمكالمات التي تم الرد عليها، وجداول متابعة العملاء المحتملين، والعملاء الذين يحتاجون إلى معلومات أو خدمات إضافية. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية بفعالية واحترافية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهيًا وكتابيًا. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مركز الاتصالات في مركز الطب المتقدم للتخصصات الدقيقة. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية لضمان تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مركز الطب المتقدم للتخصصات الدقيقة.

fc258f23cd507430.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن سائق سيارة خاص للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، بمنطقة عسير. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية قيادة السيارة لنقل الركاب، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والسلامة. الدور بدوام كامل ويشمل إجراء الفحوصات الدورية للسيارة ورفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة السيارة لنقل الركاب مع ضمان الالتزام بالمواعيد المحددة، والتبليغ الفوري عن أي تأخير اضطراري. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، والتأكد من عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية منتظمة للسيارة لمعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تظهر. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة التي تتطلب فحص الخبراء عند ملاحظة أي خلل أثناء القيادة. الالتزام التام بالأدلة والإجراءات التشغيلية، بالإضافة إلى أدلة المواصفات والمعايير وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والمتطلبات خبرة سابقة في مجال قيادة السيارات الخاصة أو ما يعادلها. حيازة شهادة قياس مستوى الكفاءة في القيادة. معرفة قوية بمبادئ وممارسات القيادة الآمنة والقدرة على الحفاظ على سجل قيادة خالٍ من المخالفات. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة أبها، ضمن فريق شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات. يجب على المتقدم أن يكون مستعدًا للالتزام بجدول زمني منتظم لضمان نقل الركاب بكفاءة وأمان. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الوظيفة في شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات.

fcef49194da6aa5c.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Risk Manager to lead the development and enforcement of comprehensive health, safety, and risk management programs within its facilities. This full-time position is based in Makkah and Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in risk management. Key Responsibilities Lead the implementation and maintenance of organizational risk programs as defined by Fakeeh Care's risk management framework. Develop annual risk registers with associated KPIs and collaborate with risk owners to manage and mitigate risks throughout the year. Oversee departmental risk management activities and ensure alignment with facility standards. Prepare periodic risk register reports detailing progress and challenges. Participate in environmental rounds, safety programs, and drill outcomes, following up on remedial action plans. Manage the reporting and updating of patient safety incidents, near misses, including Medication Incident Reports and Against Medical Advice Reports. Analyze complex data from incident investigations to develop action plans for substantive improvements. Lead Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and other process improvement initiatives to proactively address potential risks. Conduct tracers for selected processes, identify gaps, and develop remedial action plans. Assist the QRM director in conducting Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) for high-risk events, near misses, and sentinel events. Maintain clear communication with management regarding safety incidents, investigation progress, and escalation of critical areas. Develop and implement training programs to enhance staff participation in quality and risk management efforts. Assist in the creation and revision of policies related to safety and accreditation, supporting adherence to regulatory requirements. Continuous Improvement Responsibilities Perform all duties in alignment with Fakeeh's Person-Centered care values. Act as an advocate for patient safety. Contribute actively to continuous improvement initiatives within the scope of the role. Adhere to safety protocols and proactively address job-related safety concerns. Maintain strict confidentiality of all sensitive information. Comply with cybersecurity policies and standards, participating in awareness training. Uphold Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies, and ethical standards. Complete mandatory education requirements prior to expiration. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in risk management, preferably within a healthcare setting. Demonstrated ability to lead and implement comprehensive health and safety/risk management programs. Strong analytical skills for incident investigation and data interpretation. Experience with FMEA, process improvement (PI) initiatives, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Fakeeh Care Group facilities located in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic healthcare environment focused on patient safety and continuous quality improvement. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

fcab0274fc1dfd85.job_title: فرص عمل موسمية للسعوديين – محاسب زبائن (كاشير)
fcab0274fc1dfd85.description: فرصة عمل موسمية – محاسب زبائن (كاشير) نبحث عن محاسبي زبائن سعوديين، ممن تزيد أعمارهم على 18 عامًا، للعمل لمدة شهر في فروع الشركة بجميع أنحاء المملكة. تفاصيل العمل: الراتب الشهري: 3,000 ريال سعودي. ساعات العمل: 9 ساعات يوميًا، تشمل ساعة راحة. الإجازة الأسبوعية: يومان. المهام والمسؤوليات: استقبال العملاء وتقديم خدمة مميزة. تسجيل المنتجات وإتمام عمليات البيع عبر نظام نقاط البيع. تحصيل المدفوعات النقدية والإلكترونية بدقة. مطابقة النقدية مع تقارير المبيعات وتسليم العهدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة الكاشير. إبلاغ المشرف عن أي فروقات مالية أو مشكلات أثناء العمل. المتطلبات: سعودي الجنسية، والعمر أكبر من 18 عامًا. التفرغ للعمل طوال مدة الشهر. الالتزام بالمواعيد والاستعداد للعمل بنظام الورديات. مهارات جيدة في التواصل وخدمة العملاء. الدقة والأمانة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. تُعطى الأولوية لمن لديه بطاقة بلدية «شهادة صحية» سارية أو فحص طبي ساري المفعول.

fc24e61d7cb0a143.description: About the Role Airbus Americas Customer Services, Inc. is seeking an Upgrade Services Project Manager (Systems / Airframe) to join their team in Al Qatif. This permanent position is critical within the Airbus Upgrades Business line, focusing on the planning, leadership, and execution of activities related to commercial aircraft avionics and airframe modifications for in-service Airbus aircraft. Role Context and Collaboration The Upgrade Project Manager (UPM) will work closely with Airline Customers, maintenance facilities (MROs), and internal Airbus engineering and supply chain experts. The primary objective is to deliver end-to-end solutions for airlines, ensuring modifications are implemented effectively and efficiently. This role operates within a global context, supporting Airbus products across various stages of the aircraft life cycle. Key Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of small, medium, and large systems and airframe projects from contract signature through project closure. Develop comprehensive project plans and master schedules, including timelines, milestones, and critical paths. Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects, ensuring milestones are met. Ensure the timely delivery of complete and accurate systems/airframe retrofit solutions to customers. Provide visibility to all project members and stakeholders regarding project progress. Assist customers in preparing for upgrade solution embodiment and support the embodiment phase as required. Provide support to Offer Managers for new offers and generate delta offers. Conduct continuous risk and opportunity assessments, developing mitigation strategies when necessary. Contribute to the profitability of the Airbus upgrade organization and manage the P&L for individual projects, including execution within predefined budgets and invoicing. Provide technical support to sales to ensure customer acceptance of offers in accordance with AOP targets. Lead cross-functional teams consisting of engineering, supply chain, and certification experts. Act as the primary point of contact for customers and internal Multi-Functional Teams (MFTs). Contribute to the continuous improvement of the upgrade operating system and enhance the competitiveness of systems/airframe offerings. Work Environment The Engineering Center in Mobile, Alabama, serves as a hub for hundreds of Airbus engineers involved in the design and development of commercial aircraft cabins, including aftermarket upgrades, reconfigurations, and services globally. This role supports a dynamic environment focused on complex, highly engineered machines and is involved at all stages of the aircraft life cycle. Company Culture and Integrity Airbus supports flexible working arrangements where possible to foster innovative thinking and collaboration. The company emphasizes awareness of potential compliance risks and a commitment to acting with integrity, which is foundational to its success, reputation, and sustainable growth.

fc32b6c1842aff02.description: إعلان توظيف: باريستا ماهر نحن في حاجة إلى باريستا ماهر للانضمام إلى فريقنا! إذا كنت شغوفًا بالقهوة ولديك خبرة في إعداد المشروبات، فهذا هو المكان المناسب لك. المتطلبات: خبرة سابقة كـ باريستا معرفة بأنواع القهوة وطرق التحضير مهارات تواصل جيدة القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط ساعات العمل: 9 ساعات يوميًا المميزات: بيئة عمل ودودة راتب تنافسي فرص للتطوير المهني

fc91af3c57b8283a.description: About Binzagr For Industry and Maintenance Binzagr For Industry and Maintenance is seeking an Onboarding Officer to join their team in Jubail, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on managing employee contracts and coordinating essential HR activities. Role Purpose The Onboarding Officer is responsible for managing employee contracts and coordinating all onboarding and offboarding activities. This role ensures compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable labor laws, while maintaining accurate employee documentation and completing all employment-related formalities efficiently and on time. Key Responsibilities Prepare, issue, and manage employment contracts, including amendments, renewals, and terminations, in accordance with company policies and labor laws. Process employment contracts electronically through government platforms and HR systems, ensuring accuracy and timely completion. Coordinate employee onboarding activities, including document collection, contract signing, medical examinations, work permits, residency requirements, and other pre-employment formalities. Coordinate employee offboarding activities, such as resignation processing, contract termination, clearance procedures, exit formalities, and final documentation. Manage employee registration, contract updates, renewals, and terminations via relevant government platforms, including Qiwa. Ensure all required employee documents are collected, verified, maintained, and properly archived according to company procedures. Collaborate with HR, Recruitment, Payroll, Government Relations, and other departments to ensure smooth onboarding and offboarding processes. Monitor contract expiration dates and employee documentation to ensure timely renewals and prevent compliance issues. Provide employees with information regarding employment contracts, company policies, onboarding requirements, and offboarding procedures. Maintain accurate employee records and prepare regular reports on contract status, renewals, onboarding, and offboarding activities. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable Saudi Labor Law requirements. Undertake additional related responsibilities as assigned by the line manager. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a similar role. Demonstrated ability to manage employee contracts and HR formalities. Familiarity with government platforms for employment processing. Location This position is based in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity.

fcaf199772c27313.description: About the Role BDO Saudi Arabia, Dr. Mohamed Al-Amri & Co. is seeking a Project Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the delivery of client engagements, overseeing day-to-day project management, stakeholder engagement, and reporting to client executive leadership. Key Responsibilities Plan and manage project scope, schedule, resources, and deliverables. Coordinate BDO, client, and third-party teams across all project activities. Engage stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership. Monitor progress and milestones; maintain RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and action logs, and resolve issues. Prepare status reports and steering committee packs. Manage change requests, deliverable quality, project closure, and handover processes. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in project management. The role requires a professional capable of managing complex client engagements and coordinating diverse teams effectively. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a professional services environment. The Project Manager will work closely with internal BDO teams, clients, and third-party stakeholders. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join BDO Saudi Arabia, Dr. Mohamed Al-Amri & Co.

fcb5618270a35ce9.company_name: شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي
fcb5618270a35ce9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ياسر احمد العقبي للاستشارات المهنية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف الهندسي وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، مع توضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل المواقع الإنشائية. مهارات قوية في إعداد وتدقيق التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع وضمان الجودة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في الاستشارات الهندسية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم التطور المهني. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين ذوي الخبرة المناسبة للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة ياسر احمد العقبي للاستشارات المهنية.

fc576ba95ec58cc5.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an Assistant Manager, Restaurants to join their team in Medina, Central Area District. This full-time role involves assisting in the daily supervision of restaurant operations, focusing on guest and employee satisfaction, and ensuring operational efficiency. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Assist in the daily supervision of restaurant operations, including Restaurants/Bars and Room Service where applicable. Support menu planning and maintain sanitation standards. Assist servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods and high demand times. Monitor employees to ensure performance expectations are met and provide feedback on service behaviors. Supervise daily shift operations and manage the restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager. Ensure all employees have proper supplies, equipment, and uniforms. Communicate any issues regarding food quality and service levels to the Chef and Restaurant Manager. Ensure compliance with all restaurant policies, standards, and procedures, including monitoring alcohol beverage service in accordance with local laws. Interact with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels, and handle guest problems and complaints. Supervise staffing levels to meet guest service, operational needs, and financial objectives. Conduct ongoing training initiatives and communicate performance expectations to employees. Open and close restaurant shifts. Qualifications and Experience High school diploma or GED with 4 years of experience in food and beverage, culinary, or a related professional area. Alternatively, a 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or a related major, with 2 years of experience in food and beverage, culinary, or a related professional area. Demonstrated ability to improve guest and employee satisfaction. Experience in determining and implementing training needs to achieve goals. Core Competencies Ability to handle employee questions and concerns effectively. Strong communication skills to convey departmental goals clearly and consistently. Proficiency in managing operations to achieve or exceed budgeted goals. Commitment to providing exceptional customer service and setting a positive example for guest relations. Capability to analyze information and evaluate results to solve problems and choose optimal solutions. Ability to recognize good quality products and presentations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Medina, within the Central Area District, for Marriott International. The role involves working closely with restaurant teams and management to ensure smooth daily operations and high service standards.

fca7c05cf1bc1fee.description: About Business Tribune Global Company Ltd (BTGC) Business Tribune Global Company Ltd (BTGC) is a specialized industrial supply and electro-mechanical equipment distributor. The company serves industrial sectors across Saudi Arabia, operating from its corporate base in Dammam with commercial operations throughout the Kingdom. BTGC delivers technical solutions to high-demand industries and is expanding its operations to manage high-volume RFQs and dedicated industrial divisions. The Role: Indoor Sales Engineer Global Sourcing BTGC is seeking a proactive and technically proficient Saudi Sales Engineer to join the team as an Indoor Sales Engineer. This full-time position, based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, involves bridging complex client technical requirements with global supply chains. The role focuses on technical estimating, sourcing, and client fulfillment, utilizing an engineering background to evaluate supplier capabilities and secure optimal technical and commercial solutions. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and a deep understanding of local purchasing protocols, alongside proven capability in sourcing directly from global vendors and international OEMs. Key Responsibilities Review and process incoming client RFQs, translating complex technical requirements into accurate, competitive commercial proposals. Identify, evaluate, and source electro-mechanical equipment and industrial materials from global manufacturers. Conduct rigorous compliance checks on international trading partners, ensuring they meet required standards (*, verified tenure, third-party inspection audits like SGS/TÜV, and official commercial registrations). Navigate local supply networks and procurement standards, aligning global imports with specific localized project requirements and Aramco standards where applicable. Work closely with estimating and technical teams to ensure proposed solutions meet the exact specifications of clients in heavy industry sectors. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of global commodity pricing, shipping logistics, and customs regulations to optimize margins and delivery timelines. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s Degree. Industry Expertise: Demonstrated previous experience within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, and Mining sectors. Sourcing Acumen: Proven track record of international procurement, global vendor negotiation, and technical sourcing. Local Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Saudi industrial landscape, major client procurement portals, and local supply chain dynamics. Technical Skills: Ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings, datasheets, and technical specifications. Communication: Exceptional English and Arabic communication skills, with the ability to negotiate effectively across different cultures and time zones. Work Environment This role is based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, and operates within a full-time work structure. The successful candidate will be an internal driver for technical estimating, sourcing, and client fulfillment, working collaboratively with estimating and technical teams. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary information will be disclosed during the interview process.

fc407062a4033de7.description: Join our Water & Maritime team in Jeddah and help shape high-quality proposals and tenders for projects across the Middle East. In this regional role, you will bring structure to complex submission processes, connect technical and commercial teams, and use data and digital tools to strengthen our business development activities. What you will do as a Tender Desk Assistant As a Tender Desk Assistant, you will support proposal, tender and business development activities across the Middle East. Working closely with our Business Development, Technical and Marketing teams, you will help qualify opportunities, coordinate submissions and improve the quality and efficiency of our regional business development processes. You will manage multiple requirements and deadlines while ensuring that proposal materials are clear, compliant and of a consistently high standard. You will also use CRM data, reporting tools and AI-enabled solutions to improve proposal development, document management and team productivity. Coordinate proposals and tenders: Support regional business development activities and coordinate high-quality, compliant submissions, from preparing templates and schedules to managing reviews, stakeholder input and final submission. Identify and qualify opportunities: Monitor tender portals, procurement platforms and client announcements, conduct market research across priority countries and sectors, screen leads and support opportunity qualification with Business Development teams.
